home.heroSubtitle: Financial organization to make better decisions.

why.title: Clarity
why.description: A clear picture of your real financial situation: what you have, what you owe and how much you save.

why.title: Savings control
why.description: Understand where your money goes each month and make decisions about your savings rate.

why.title: Reduce debt
why.description: Identify your debt ratio and prioritize which debts to pay off first.

why.title: Informed decisions
why.description: Clear indicators to decide with data, not intuition or outside pressure.

why.title: Plan your goals
why.description: Set concrete goals (emergency fund, home, early retirement) and track your progress.

home.experienceBio: Julià Regader combines university teaching with practical financial education. As a university professor of organization and operations, and as a personal investor for years, he helps people and families put their wealth in order and understand their own financial decisions, with a hands-on approach and no unnecessary jargon.
experienceHighlights: University professor of organization and operations

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Choose how you want to start organizing your wealth with JuliusCapital.
services.planSubtitle: For anyone who wants to put their whole wealth in order and have a living dashboard.
planIncludes: Initial meeting to understand your situation and your goals
Full setup of your financial dashboard (income, expenses, assets, liabilities)
Calculation of your key indicators: net worth, savings, debt, liquidity
Session to review investment options and tools and define your own strategy
Access to your private area: monthly tracking and wealth evolution
services.sessionSubtitle: For a one-off consultation, without needing to buy the full plan.
sessionIncludes: 1-hour session, in person or by video call
Answers to specific questions about your financial situation
Ideal if you already use the app and want to review your progress or a specific topic

faqs.q: Do I need the 329 € plan to book a single session?
faqs.a: No, the 80 € individual session is independent and you can book it without having bought the plan.

faqs.q: Does JuliusCapital tell me what to invest in?
faqs.a: No. JuliusCapital is a wealth organization and education tool. In sessions we review options and tools so you define your own strategy; the investment decision is always yours.

faqs.q: Can I pay for the 80 € session later?
faqs.a: Yes: you can book a day and time without paying in advance, and pay for the session afterwards (or on the spot, if you prefer).
